title: A Big Party
setting: A bright community hall with decorations and long tables of food.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Grandpa Joe
characters.look: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan)

sentences.en: Ben, Lily and their cousin arrive together.
sentences.zh: 本、莉莉和他们的表姐一起到达。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) and their cousin (a girl of about twelve with long black hair and a yellow shirt) walk hand in hand toward a bright decorated community hall.
sentences.narration: Ben, Lily and their cousin walk hand in hand toward a bright decorated community hall.

sentence_targets.en: with another person or other people

sentence_targets.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
sentence_targets.en: A child of your aunt or uncle

sentences.en: At the door, Grandpa Joe welcomes them.
sentences.zh: 乔爷爷在门口欢迎他们。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) opens the hall door wide and smiles at Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) and their cousin (a girl of about twelve with long black hair and a yellow shirt).
sentences.narration: Grandpa Joe opens the hall door wide and smiles at Ben, Lily and their cousin.

sentence_targets.en: A movable barrier used to open or close an entrance.
to greet someone warmly or accept something with pleasure

sentences.en: Many people from different countries are inside.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多来自不同国家的人。
sentences.scene_prompt: A busy decorated community hall full of people in clothes from many different countries, talking and laughing.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a hall full of many different people; that they come from different countries can only be guessed.
sentences.narration: A busy decorated community hall full of people in clothes from many different countries, talking and laughing.

sentence_targets.en: Human beings considered together or referred to in general.

sentences.en: Two Chinese women make dumplings at a table.
sentences.zh: 两位中国女士在桌边包饺子。
sentences.scene_prompt: In the decorated hall, two Chinese women fold dumplings together at a long table.
sentences.narration: In the decorated hall, two Chinese women fold dumplings together at a long table.

sentence_targets.en: More than one adult female person.
Relating to China, its people, or its languages.

sentences.en: Grandpa Joe was born in a small German town.
sentences.zh: 乔爷爷出生在德国的一个小镇。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) shows Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) an old photo of a small German town with a church and a German flag.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Grandpa Joe with a photo of a small German town; that he was born there can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Grandpa Joe shows Ben and Lily an old photo of a small German town with a church and a German flag.

sentence_targets.en: Brought into the world as a baby
relating to Germany, its people, or its language

sentences.en: Each parent brings a famous dish from their country.
sentences.zh: 每位家长都带来一道自己国家的名菜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mothers and fathers put many colourful dishes from around the world on a long table in the hall.
sentences.draw_note: Shows parents bringing many dishes; 'famous' and 'their country' can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Mothers and fathers put many colourful dishes from around the world on a long table in the hall.

sentences.en: Lily has an idea: a big dance for everyone.
sentences.zh: 莉莉有个主意：大家一起跳个大舞。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) jumps up with a bright smile and spreads her arms wide in front of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan).
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily excited with a sudden idea; what the idea is only becomes clear in the next picture.
sentences.narration: Lily jumps up with a bright smile and spreads her arms wide in front of Ben and Grandpa Joe.

sentence_targets.en: Every person in a group, or all people.
A thought or suggestion about what to do.

sentences.en: Every person in the room joins the dance.
sentences.zh: 房间里的每个人都加入了舞蹈。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots), Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) and all the people in the hall dance together in a big circle.
sentences.narration: Ben, Lily, Grandpa Joe and all the people in the hall dance together in a big circle.

sentence_targets.en: To become a member or take part with others.
